groups.problem: record_for_host compares lower(host) to uri.host without downcasing it, so mixed-case referers never match.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same one-sided case normalization in the query and propose host.downcase.

groups.problem: The migration reads execute(...)[0]['id'] / [0]['value'] with no check for an empty result, which raises NoMethodError when the setting row is missing.
groups.rationale: Same nil dereference on empty query results in the same migration lines, with the same fix.

groups.problem: The before_validation block calls host.sub! without a nil check, so a missing host raises NoMethodError and returns a 500.
groups.rationale: Both report the missing nil guard on host in before_validation. S11's note about in-place mutation is part of its proposed fix.

groups.problem: update and destroy use where(...).first without a nil check, so an unknown id raises NoMethodError instead of returning a 404.
groups.rationale: Same missing-record handling in the same controller actions, with the same fix: use find.

problems: The execute(...)[0]['id'] lookup raises NoMethodError when no setting row exists.
